messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a lightweight 'capability token' for svc-to-svc auth to reduce API key blast radius. Short-lived, signed, bound to route/org/project.
ajay: Two Qs: 1) per-request verification cost? 2) high QPS migration?
sasha: Concerned about migration impact for long-lived backend keys. Need fallback.
ken: Implementation sketch: auth-broker mints short TTL tokens, signed by HSM. Validators use cached JWKs. TTL 60-900s.
emily: Rollout: route-level opt-in. Canary accepts both creds and logs reasons; after stable week, enforce.
maria: Pros: smaller blast radius, route-level least-privilege. Cons: broker + rotation complexity. Need perf tests.
ajay: For QPS, consider HMAC tokens for internal-only paths to avoid asymmetric cost.
sasha: Migration checklist: broker API spec, client libs, JWK distribution + rotation, phased opt-in, enforcement.
ken: Edge case: offline batch jobs -> allow bounded long-lived project-scoped tokens with strict rotation. Add tenant-affinity claim.
emily: Observability: emit X-Accepted-Credential, token-type, minting-principal, route-claim, audit-id. Auto-rollback if errors >5% during canary.
maria: Security: embed org/project and audience in claims for cheap validation.
ajay: Broker should attestate binding to service identity and origins to avoid region replay.
sasha: Perf plan: benchmark 10k rps for HMAC vs RSA/EC, measure p95 latency/CPU. Simulate JWK rotation churn.
ken: SDK example:
POST /v1/mint { "service":"ingest-worker", "routes":["/v1/ingest"], "ttl":300 }
Token claims: { "iss":"auth-broker", "sub":"svc:ingest-worker", "aud":"/v1/ingest", "org":"org-123", "exp":1751111511 }
ops-bot: Feature-flag created: capability-auth in staging. Use `ff toggle capability-auth on --env=staging`.
emily: I'll add rollout observability and logs.
sasha: I'll own migration playbook.
ajay: I'll build perf harness and share EOW.
ken: I'll draft broker API + rotation doc.
maria: I'll open RFC PR tomorrow unless objections. :thumbsup:
